node.statement: The registered definition column-hilbert-inner-product-displays states the extended display 1dQ_ip_ext with <Y,V>_n=sum_i<[Y]_{i1},[V]_{i1}>. Under the coordinate notation Y_i=[Y]_{i1} and V_i=[V]_{i1}, this is exactly <Y,V>_n=sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. Hence the proposed assignment <Y,V>_n prime=2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i> fails that definitional equality whenever the sum is nonzero (for example Y=V=(1,0) in the exact scalar corner), so it is not a model of the permitted context. Together with node 1.3.2.2.3, which gives Y^dagger dot V=(sum_i<Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q, substitution of the registered equality yields Y^dagger dot V=<Y,V>_n*u_Q with coefficient one.
